in_sanskrit.name: सनातन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sanskrit root 'san' meaning 'eternal, timeless, primordial' and the suffix 'tana' meaning 'that which exists or continues'. Thus, the name Sanatana means 'eternal, everlasting, primeval'.

in_hindi.name: सनातन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sanatana in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'सनातन' (sanātana), which translates to 'eternal, everlasting, primeval'. In Hindi, the name is pronounced as 'सनातन' and its meaning is 'संतान' (santāna), which means 'source, origin, ancestry'.

in_tamil.name: சநாதன
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Sanatana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'सनातन' (sanātana). The meaning of Sanatana in Tamil is 'ஆதரவாற்கள் இல்லாமல்' (ādharavāṟkāl ilāmal), which translates to 'eternal, everlasting, primeval'. In Tamil, the name is pronounced as 'சநாதன' and its meaning is 'source, origin, ancestry'.

in_telugu.name: సనాతన
